title: Rally component diagram
description: Rally, table tennis for the browser: the client plays matches, and the Worker replays one-player matches before they go on the table.

components.name: Rally
components.responsibility: One game: the browser client and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Browser game
components.responsibility: The engine, drawing, input, sound, menus and, where it has them, online play.

components.name: High-score Worker
components.responsibility: The high-score API and public scores page; replays each game before listing it.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at games.icelander.net (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

relationships.description: Asks for a seed (POST api/game), submits the game (POST api/score) and loads the table (GET api/scores).
Replays matches with src/engine/match.ts and cleans names with src/name.ts.
Joins online matches through the relay WebSocket, and reads /me for a signed-in player's name.
